{{Quote|I write from a clearing at the garrison's outskirts, amid the encampments of the planet's doctrinists, who desire a return to the Empire's isolationism. They have often stood in opposition to our Emperor&mdash;but today, we are all Sith.|Darth Malgus, ''Book of Sith''|<ref name="Book of Sith" />}}
'''Doctrinists''' were a faction of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who desired return to the isolationism. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ashas Ree/Legends|Ashas Ree]] was the site of doctrinist encampments around [[3660 BBY]].<ref name="Book of Sith" />

{{Company-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Doctrinists were first mentioned in the [[2012]] resource guide ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'', which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="Book of Sith" />
